returns._0: A strictly increasing identifier, bumped once per accepted attestation.
The unix timestamp of the latest attestation.
The total USDC reserves currently attested (6-decimal USDC units).

confirmAttestor(address).details: Permissionless on purpose: the announcement is the authorising act, and the delay is what protects holders. Anyone may finish the (already public) job.

params.attestor: The first registered attestor. Required: an oracle with an empty attestor set can never accept a proof, so it is a deployment error.

submitAttestation(uint256,uint256,uint25.details: Callable by anyone; the signature, not the caller, is the authority.

ATTESTOR_GRACE().notice: An announced attestor that is not confirmed within this window after its eta expires, so a forgotten proposal cannot be revived years later.

ATTESTOR_TIMELOCK().notice: Delay between announcing a new attestor and it being able to sign.

announceAttestor(address).notice: Step 1 of adding an attestor. Public the moment it is announced; settlement holders have `ATTESTOR_TIMELOCK` to react before the key can sign.

attestationDigest(uint256,uint256,uint25.notice: Hash that an attestor signs (EIP-712 typed data).

attestorEta(address).notice: Timestamp at which an announced attestor may be confirmed. 0 = none.

confirmAttestor(address).notice: Step 2, only after the timelock and only inside the grace window.

nonce().notice: Last consumed attestation nonce. The next must be exactly this + 1.

revokeAttestor(address).notice: Revoke an attestor immediately. Removal only ever shrinks what this oracle will believe, so it is not delayed: a leaked key is revocable now.

submitAttestation(uint256,uint256,uint25.notice: Accept a USDC reserve attestation if and only if it carries a valid signature from a registered attestor over a fresh, unreplayed nonce.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Two-step ownership handover: a typo cannot orphan the oracle.
